tasks.description: Analyze the correlation between ambient temperature and surface temperature to understand diurnal heating and cooling patterns.
Calculate the daily average solar radiation to assess exposure cycles and potential cloud cover impact.
Track the trends in relative humidity over time to monitor microclimatic changes.
Monitor soil moisture levels and watermark tension to evaluate hydrological conditions in the alpine environment.
Calculate wind vector using wind speed and direction to profile wind patterns and detect drafts.
Profile precipitation events using the rain meter data and correlate with atmospheric variables.
